description: Update Archive Status. Part of the Archive APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

uniqueName.description: Unique identifier for the record. Optional.

mobileNumber.description: Mobile number with country code when applicable. Mandatory.

linkedEntities.description: Array of linked entities values. Optional.

archiveOnly.description: When true, applies the archive only filter or flag. Optional.

action.description: Action. Allowed values: PRINCIPAL, COMPANY_UNIQUE_NAME_PATH_PARAM, DUEPERIOD, PAGE, COUNT, RAZORPAY, TRANSFER, UNASSIGNED, UNARCHIVED, CONTENT_TYPE, MESSAGING_PRODUCT, TYPE, POLICY, LANGUAGE_CODE. Optional.
